name: @dawnchat/assistant-workspace
// workspace purpose: Assistant source workspace for SDK packages and assistant templates. Runtime plugin installs still happen after backend rewrite in user plugin directories.

scripts.template:mobile:build: bun run template:mobile:vue-tsc && bun run template:mobile:vite-build
scripts.build:sdk: bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-core build && bun run --filter @dawnchat/host-orchestration-sdk build && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-app-sdk build && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-chat-ui build
scripts.verify:sdk: bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-core typecheck && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-core test && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-core build && bun run --filter @dawnchat/host-orchestration-sdk typecheck && bun run --filter @dawnchat/host-orchestration-sdk test && bun run --filter @dawnchat/host-orchestration-sdk build && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-app-sdk typecheck && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-app-sdk test && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-app-sdk build && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-chat-ui typecheck && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-chat-ui test && bun run --filter @dawnchat/assistant-chat-ui build
scripts.build:templates: bun run --filter desktop-ai-assistant-vue-web build && bun run --filter web-ai-assistant-vue-web build && bun run --filter mobile-ai-assistant-ionic-web build
scripts.verify:templates: bun run verify:sdk && bun run --filter desktop-ai-assistant-vue-web verify && bun run --filter web-ai-assistant-vue-web verify && bun run --filter mobile-ai-assistant-ionic-web verify
